audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Ryze wins Level 6 and Kled wins 2+ items, but both why-strings say the opposite (Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! is Kled's level-6 window; full-build Ryze out-ranges Kled late) and the 46.99% win rate does not support Kled owning the late game.
audit.why: Kled R (140s rank 1) is a hard engage/knock-out of a root chain at 6, while Ryze's Realm Warp is a 180s delayed group teleport, not a duel tool. Late, Spell Flux at 2.5s and Rune Prison at 615 range out-range Kled's 550 E.
audit.corrected: phases[4]/win[4] -> Kled (7/10); phases[6]/win[6] -> Ryze (3/10), proposed as paired full+content rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes text credited Bear Trap with percent-HP shred and gave Kled's W the name 'Jousting Procs'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Kled Q is flat physical damage plus a yank; no percentHealth flag. Jousting is Kled's E (dash), not W — W is Violent Tendencies, four fast attacks with a bigger fourth hit.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten to Violent Tendencies + Bear Trap yank; percent-HP claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly called Rune Prison a 'point-blank root' and described a 'Q-then-E root chain'. It also claimed Ryze's shield eats Kled's burst.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 615 range and only ROOTS if Flux (E, Spell Flux) is already on the target — otherwise it is a damage+slow. The chain is E then W, not Q then E. Ryze has no shield anywhere in his kit; that was fabricated.
audit.corrected: All references rewritten: dodge Spell Flux and the cage is only a slow; Overload is a first-target projectile so the minion wave blocks it; shield claim deleted.

audit.why: Rune Prison 11s at rank 1, Spell Flux 3.5s at rank 1 (2.5s at rank 5), Kled R 140s at rank 1 — these make the advice concrete.
Spell-shield/QSS/tenacity eligibility is not in Riot's text and the brief lists no missing interactions for this pair; nothing asserted.

edits.before: CHAAAARGE turns any side wave into a cross-map gank. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! knocks him out of his root chain into your tower; Realm Warp is a 180s reposition, not a duel answer.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ryze carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on he out-ranges you: Spell Flux and Rune Prison on cooldown, 8.5/10 carry threat — close it before the map decides.

edits.before: W brings the Jousting Procs online and his percent-HP Q shreds him — you win the first real all-in before his resets matter.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies arms four fast attacks and Bear Trap yanks him in — take the all-in at 2 while Rune Prison is still only a slow.

edits.before: W's Jousting Procs and the full E-W-E re-E combo land your only clean kill window before his Q/E resets snowball.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies' four attacks plus the E-W-E re-E combo land your cleanest kill before Spell Flux starts resetting Overload.

edits.before: Eclipse/Trinity sheen burst plus Bear Trap percent-HP shred is your peak, but Ryze's Tear/Archangel's already buys his root-chain.
edits.after: Eclipse sheen burst plus a Bear Trap yank into the full W is your peak, but Ryze's Tear/Archangel's already funds his root chain.

edits.before: Ryze owns Level 1 — his ranged Q chips Skaarl while you have no spammable answer, so don't trade into it, just protect your mount health. Your whole window is Levels 2-3: once W's on-hit shots and the E-W-E re-E combo are up, dash in, W-pull, and trap him before his Q/E resets and Tear stacking come online. The thing to dodge is the Q-then-E root chain — if he lands it your dash gets locked and he kites Skaarl out, so bait the root or wait the E cooldown before you commit.
edits.after: Ryze owns Level 1 — Overload chips Skaarl from 1000 range while you have no answer, so don't trade into it, just protect mount health. Your window is Levels 2-3: once Violent Tendencies and the Jousting re-cast are up, dash in, Bear Trap, and burn him before Tear stacking comes online. What locks you down is Spell Flux first — Rune Prison only slows a clean target, so step out of the orb's splash and his 11s cage costs him the wave for nothing.

edits.before: This is where the 47% bites. A full-build Ryze is a ranged raid-boss: his Q/E spam roots you on cooldown, his shield eats your burst, and he whittles Skaarl from outside your E range every fight while his realm warp R warps your splitpush plan. You don't out-scale him — your job is to have already snowballed off the 2-3 and 6 windows. If lane went even, sidelane safe, group only with a flank R, and never facecheck for a root.
edits.after: This is where the 47% bites. A full-build Ryze is a ranged raid-boss: Spell Flux every 2.5s keeps Flux on you so every Rune Prison roots instead of slows, and he chips Skaarl from 615 while Realm Warp drops his team onto your splitpush. You don't out-scale him — your job is to have already snowballed off the 2-3 and 6 windows. If lane went even, sidelane safe, group only with a flank R, and never facecheck for a root.

edits.before: Land the Q/E root combo to peel your E dash and kite Skaarl down from range
edits.after: Land Spell Flux first so Rune Prison roots instead of slows, then kite Skaarl

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: 11s at rank 1, 615 range — it only roots if Spell Flux is already on you, so break the orb first. - Your Bear Trap: never spend it on chip. - Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison only roots a Spell Flux target — dodge the orb and his cage is just a slow.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — Q-trap + courage all-in.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux, and Overload stops on the first target — stand behind the wave, then Bear Trap and all-in.

notes: Ryze has no shield in his kit; the 'his shield eats your burst' line in late was fabricated and is removed. Kled's W is Violent Tendencies, not 'Jousting Procs' (Jousting is E). Bear Trap has no percent-health component in Riot's text. Packet levelChart (Ryze/Kled/Kled/Skill/Kled/Skill/Ryze) still disagrees with the page chart at rows 1, 3 and 5; I only flipped rows 4 and 6 where the page contradicted its own why-strings, and left the rest alone rather than trusting the packet chart over consistent prose.
